init_NSchools: create an NSchools instance with model attributes like num_states, num_districts_per_state, and scale parameters
get_vars_NSchools: get the list of seven MCMC variable names including sigma and beta parameters from NSchools
format_data_to_jags_NSchools: format an xarray dataset into a JAGS-ready dictionary with 1-based indices and observed data
extract_data_from_jags_NSchools: extract JAGS MCMC samples into an xarray dataset with draw, state, district, and type coordinates
get_code_NSchools: get the JAGS model code string defining hierarchical priors and likelihood for the n schools problem
